crossRefs.note: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two coats each.

translations.web: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
translations.bsb: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—
translations.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
translations.asv: and he charged them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no bread, no wallet, now money in their purse;
